nodes.summary: The free mass of `t` in `Λ_m` equals the free mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m`.
nodes.title: Translation covariance of free box masses

nodes.summary: The wired mass of `t` in `Λ_m` equals the wired mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m`.
nodes.title: Translation covariance of wired box masses

nodes.summary: The wired box measure on `Λ_m`, pushed to `ℤ^d`, gives `A_t` the box mass of `t`.
nodes.title: Wired box measure of an all-open event equals its box mass

nodes.summary: Restatement of `cdc_wired_multiOpenEvent_tendsto`: the wired box probabilities of `A_t` converge to the wired infinite-volume probability.
nodes.title: Wired all-open probabilities converge to the infinite-volume value

nodes.summary: The free box measure on `Λ_m`, pushed to `ℤ^d`, gives `A_t` the box mass of `t`.
nodes.title: Free box measure of an all-open event equals its box mass

nodes.summary: Restatement of `cdc_free_multiOpenEvent_tendsto`: the free box probabilities of `A_t` converge to the free infinite-volume probability.
nodes.title: Free all-open probabilities converge to the infinite-volume value

nodes.summary: The free infinite-volume `q = 2` measure is translation invariant if every shift has a free placement. See also `bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance without hypotheses.
nodes.title: Free translation invariance from free placements of every shift

nodes.summary: If the free mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m` eventually equals the free mass of `t'` in `Λ_m`, the free infinite-volume measure gives `A_t` and `A_{t'}` the same probability.
nodes.title: Equal free probabilities from eventually equal translated masses

nodes.summary: A free placement for the shift `g`, defined as `med_wiredPlacement` with free masses.
nodes.title: Free placement for a shift via eventually equal box masses

nodes.summary: The event `A_t` that every edge of the finite set `t` is open. On box configurations it is `cdc_boxMultiOpenEvent` (`med_boxMultiOpenEvent_eq`).
nodes.title: Event that all edges of a finite set are open

nodes.summary: The mass `∑_ω 1_{A_t}(ω) μ(ω)` of the event that every edge of `t` is open, for a weight function `μ` on a finite configuration space; it is `eventMassProb μ A_t` (`med_multiMassProb_eq_eventMassProb`).
nodes.title: Mass of the all-open event under a weight function

nodes.summary: The difference between the wired mass of `t` in `Λ_m` and the wired mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m`; it vanishes by translation covariance.
nodes.title: Difference of wired all-open masses of an edge set and its translate

nodes.summary: The wired infinite-volume `q = 2` measure is translation invariant if every shift has a wired placement. See also `flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance without hypotheses.
nodes.title: Wired translation invariance from wired placements of every shift

nodes.summary: If the wired mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m` eventually equals the wired mass of `t'` in `Λ_m`, the wired infinite-volume measure gives `A_t` and `A_{t'}` the same probability.
nodes.title: Equal wired probabilities from eventually equal translated masses

nodes.summary: A wired placement for the shift `g`: every finite edge set `s` and its shift `g⁻¹ s` are images of box edge sets `t`, `t'` of a common box `Λ_N` such that the wired mass of `t + g` in `g + Λ_m` eventually equals the wired mass of `t'` in `Λ_m`. See also `lmc_wiredPlacement`.
nodes.title: Wired placement for a shift via eventually equal box masses

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
